values: This workbook is the maintained source for the Next.js finance dashboard.
Add or update one row per business unit per reporting month on Monthly Input.
Use the first day of the month, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.
Enter plain numbers only. Do not enter currency symbols, commas, or percentage signs.
Leave unavailable data blank. Use zero only when the actual value is zero.
Enter the percentage as a number, for example 8.5 for 8.5%.
Overview is a company aggregate. Do not add it to a total of the component business units.
Add the unit to Lists before entering its monthly data.
The app should read Calculated Metrics; it will apply period filters and display formatting.
